basic_details.job_title: Saran Civil Court Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 3 Stenographer, Clerk, Peon/Orderly Posts
basic_details.short_information: Only retired employees of the Civil Courts can apply for three contractual posts – one Stenographer, one Clerk and one Peon/Orderly – in the evening court of the Saran at Chapra Judgeship, Bihar. The application, in the prescribed proforma attached to the notice, must reach the office of the Principal District and Sessions Judge, Saran at Chapra, either personally or by registered post, by 21 December 2026. The notice was issued by the Principal District and Sessions Judge, Saran at Chapra on 21 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: About the Recruiting Office
content_sections.text: The notice comes from the Office of the Principal District and Sessions Judge, Saran at Chapra, the head of the district judiciary of Saran in Bihar. The posts are support staff for the evening court of the Saran at Chapra Judgeship. The engagement follows guidelines and directions of the Hon'ble High Court, Patna, and the notice was sent to all judgeships of Bihar and uploaded to the website of the judgeship.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applications must be made in the prescribed proforma attached with the notice (the two-page application form at the end of the PDF). The completed form must reach the following office on or before 21 December 2026: The Principal District and Sessions Judge, Saran at Chapra Mode: either personally (by hand) or through registered post. The form itself states: "Form should be submitted in physical mode in the office of Principal District and Sessions Judge, Saran at Chapra". The deadline is for receipt at the office, not for dispatch. A registered post sent late may not reach in time. The notice does not mention any online or email application. The application form asks for the following details: Name of candidate (in block letters), father's/husband's name and mother's name. Date of birth (as per Matriculation) and age as on 20-11-2026. Sex, marital status and nationality. Aadhaar number (mandatory). Date of retirement and the post from which the applicant retired. The post applied for, ticked in the relevant box (Stenographer, Clerk or Peon/Orderly). Medical fitness certificate issued by Civil Surgeon, and details of any FIR/criminal case or departmental proceeding. Permanent and correspondence addresses with mobile numbers, the list of documents attached, and the signed undertaking with place and date.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The applicant must be a retired employee of the Civil Courts. Only those retired Court employees who have retired within the last three years, as per the guidelines issued by the Hon'ble High Court, Patna, are eligible. The applicant must be physically and mentally fit to discharge the duties assigned to the respective post. The applicant must possess satisfactory service records and should not have been subjected to any major disciplinary punishment during service. The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification for any of the three posts. The application form asks for the age as on 20-11-2026, but the notice prints no age limit. Candidates should check the official notification for the exact eligibility wording of each post. No amount is printed in the notice. The period of engagement, remuneration and other conditions are governed by the applicable rules, guidelines and orders of the competent authority.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Recent passport size photograph (self attested), pasted in the box on the form. Medical fitness certificate issued by Civil Surgeon (item 13 of the form). Status of any FIR/criminal case registered or pending against the applicant with the police or any court – to be attached only if the answer is yes. Other documents the applicant attaches, listed in item 18 ("List of documents attached").

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in Saran Civil Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 3 vacancies in the evening court at Saran at Chapra: one Stenographer, one Clerk and one Peon/Orderly.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The application must reach the office of the Principal District and Sessions Judge, Saran at Chapra by 21 December 2026 (21.12.2026).

faq.question: Q3. Who can apply for these posts?
faq.answer: Only retired employees of the Civil Courts who retired within the last three years, as per the guidelines of the Hon'ble High Court, Patna, can apply. They must be physically and mentally fit, have satisfactory service records and no major disciplinary punishment during service.

faq.question: Q4. What experience is needed for the Stenographer post?
faq.answer: The applicant must have the requisite experience and proficiency in shorthand and typing.

faq.question: Q5. What is required for the Clerk and Peon/Orderly posts?
faq.answer: For the Clerk post, the applicant must have adequate knowledge and experience of clerical and judicial office work. For the Peon/Orderly post, the applicant must be capable of performing the duties attached to the post.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for Saran Civil Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the prescribed proforma attached with the notice and submit it either personally or through registered post to the office of the Principal District and Sessions Judge, Saran at Chapra, so that it reaches by 21 December 2026.

faq.question: Q7. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The engagement is purely contractual, can be terminated at any time as per the direction of the Hon'ble High Court, Patna, and does not confer any right to regular appointment or continuation in service.

faq.question: Q8. What are the working hours?
faq.answer: Selected candidates must perform their duties for a minimum of five (05) hours on each working day.

faq.question: Q9. Which certificate must be given with the application form?
faq.answer: The form asks for a medical fitness certificate issued by Civil Surgeon, a recent self-attested passport size photograph and, if any FIR or criminal case was or is registered or pending, its status.
